fields.heading: Are you still interested in investing?
fields.body:
Back real green and social projects, starting from £5

You’ve made an account, but you haven’t yet added an investment.

This is the last reminder you’ll get from us, so if you’re still interested then simply login to add your first deposit. All you need is £5 and a few spare minutes.

Abundance is the UK’s platform for local investment. Our municipal investments are an easy way to add a low-risk option to your financial plans, and every pound invested will make a positive impact in the places you care about.
